Name: (CP) Novaphene's PH Foodies
Author: Novaphene
Description:
Bring a touch of Filipino flavor to your farm with a variety of traditional dishes. From savory Adobo to sweet Halo-Halo, this mod adds delicious Filipino cuisine to your game! Enjoy hearty stews, unique drinks like Barakong Kape (Barako Coffe), and sweet treats like Leche Flan. Spice up your gameplay with the rich flavors of the Philippines!

[img]https://imgur.com/4iv8dTW.png[/img]
Before going onto details:
[list]
[*]Yes, it works on Android devices and PC/Laptops
[*]No, it will not ﻿'interfere' with other mods. It should be compatible with almost any mods.
[/list]
This mod offers a few varieties of Filipino dishes from adobo to halo-halo! Also, some foods have special buffs ( ＾◡＾)っ
[b]
CHANGELOG 2.0: [/b]The machines have been separated to a new mod to add flexibility for future plans that does not directly relate to PH foods; and for other mod authors who might want to make use of those machines for their own mods.
